title: Applicant Landlord: Mel Kilrane – Respondent Tenants: Edward Gibbons, Tracy Pepper
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DR0617-34972

In the matter of Mel Kilrane [Applicant Landlord] and Edward Gibbons, Tracy Pepper
[Respondent Tenant] the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with section 121 of
the Residential Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

1.

The Notice of Termination served on the 28 April 2017, by the Applicant Landlord on
the Respondent Tenant, in respect of the tenancy of the dwelling at Apartment 4,
Park Springs, 7/9 Nephin Road, Cabra, Dublin 7, is valid.

The Respondent Tenant and all persons residing in the above dwelling shall vacate
and give up possession of the above dwelling within 28 days of the date of issue of
this Order.

The Respondent Tenant shall pay the total sum of €8650.64 to the Applicant
Landlord in the following instalments:-

i. One instalment of €4,000.00 (“The first Instalment”) on the first day of the next
month after the issue of this Determination Order.

ii. Four equal consecutive instalments at the rate of €1,000.00 per calendar month
(“The second , third , fourth and fifth instalments”) on the first day of each succeeding
month after the month in which the first instalment is paid.

iii. One further instalment of €650.64 on the first day of the month succeeding the
payment of the fifth instalment. This sum represents rent arrears of €8650.64 in
respect of the tenancy of the above dwelling.

iv. The enforcement of this Determination Order for such payment of €8650.64 will be
deferred and the total sum owing reduced by the cumulative sum paid in the monthly
instalments by the Respondent Tenant to the Applicant Landlord, on each due date,
until such time as the total sum of €8650.64 has been paid in full.

v. For the avoidance of doubt, any default in the payment of any of the instalments

shall act to cancel any further deferral and the balance due at the date of default of
any such monthly payment shall immediately become due and owing to the Applicant
Landlord.

4. The Respondent Tenant shall also pay any further rent outstanding from 12 October
2017, being the date of the adjudication hearing at the rate of €702.00 per month or
proportionate part thereof at the rate of €23.08 per day, unless lawfully varied, and
any other charges as set out in the terms of the tenancy agreement for each month
or part thereof until such time as the Respondent Tenant vacates the above dwelling.

5. The Applicant Landlord shall refund the entire of the security deposit of €648.00 to
the Respondent Tenant upon the Respondent Tenant vacating and giving up
possession of the above dwelling less any amount properly withheld in accordance
with the provisions of the Act.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board on 15 December 2017.

Noel Conroy Claire Diggin
Board Member Higher Executive Officer
